## Summary

The user-provided preliminary derivation from the attached manuscript's MODEL section, LINEAR STABILITY ANALYSIS section, and appendix material was organized into the repository derivation file. The equations were kept as candidate model content and were not promoted to `docs/validated/`.

The model candidate summary now records state variables, parameters, governing-equation structure, boundary conditions, assumptions, and unresolved issues. New open questions were added for notation, reaction order, material functions, boundary-condition signs, asymptotic assumptions, the homogeneous ODE limit, and source-appendix numerical claims.

Two additional candidate hypotheses were added:

* accessibility and diffusivity degradation are separable barrier mechanisms;
* Hopf and spinodal instabilities are distinct candidate mechanisms.
